# axm packs publish

Publish a pack to a registry

## When to use

Publish a pack to a registry

## Usage

```bash
axm packs publish [flags] <pack>
```

## Arguments

| Name   | Type   | Required | Description                                    |
| ------ | ------ | -------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `pack` | string | Yes      | Pack FQN (@owner/packs/name) or bare pack name |

## Flags

| Name                           | Type    | Required | Description                                                        |
| ------------------------------ | ------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--registry`                   | string  | No       | Target a specific named registry instead of the default            |
| `--include-dependencies`, `-d` | boolean | No       | Also publish local extensions referenced by the pack               |
| `--yes`, `-y`                  | boolean | No       | Publish without confirmation                                       |
| `--force`, `-f`                | boolean | No       | Bypass version-order warnings; published versions remain immutable |
| `--preview`                    | boolean | No       | Show what would be published without uploading                     |

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](../global-flags).

## Examples

**Share your pack on the registry**

```bash
axm packs publish @acme/packs/frontend-tools
```

**Publish to a specific registry**

```bash
axm packs publish frontend-tools --registry local
```

**Also publish the pack's local dependency extensions**

```bash
axm packs publish @acme/packs/frontend-tools --include-dependencies
```

## Requirements

None.

## Side effects

None.
